_README: Template for `asr bench --manifest`. Every value below is a PLACEHOLDER: replace
them all, and delete these _README keys or leave them -- the loader ignores keys it
Check it before spending decode time on it:
Keep the audio and the transcripts OUTSIDE the repository. Nothing in the repository
may ever contain a recording of a person.
Get a checksum with:  Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 '<audio-path>'
consent_status must be one of: granted | public-licensed | synthetic.
Anything else is refused, and that is not a formality: benchmarking somebody's voice
is processing biometric data under UU PDP No. 27/2022.

samples._comment: A clean, close-microphone recording with recorded consent.
The same room recorded from the centre of the table. This is the condition that decides whether the product works in a real meeting, and it needs at least 10 minutes in total to be worth anything.
A publicly licensed corpus sample. `license_name` must name the actual licence, because it is the only record of why this audio may be used.

_FIELD_REFERENCE.sample_uuid: required. Any stable identifier; a UUID keeps it unambiguous.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.audio_path: required. Absolute local path, outside the repository. 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV is the working-copy format; other formats are decoded by the library.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.sha256: required. Verified on load. A mismatch is refused: a run against different bytes than the manifest describes is not reproducible.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.duration_seconds: required, a number. Used for the real-time factor.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.reference_transcript_path: optional but WITHOUT IT THERE IS NO ACCURACY NUMBER. Plain UTF-8 text of exactly what was said.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.consent_status: required in practice. granted | public-licensed | synthetic. Anything else, including omitting it, is refused.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.license_name: optional, defaults to 'unknown'. Name the actual basis for using the audio.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.technical_terms: optional. Terms whose survival is measured as technical-term recall. Matched on word boundaries.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.word_timestamp_reference_path: optional. JSON list of {text, start} for word-timestamp error. Very laborious to produce by hand.
_FIELD_REFERENCE.condition: optional, free text. 'clean' and 'far-field' have their own targets in the gate.
